title: Original Anime Grow Up Show: Sunflower Circus Troupe Reveals Main Visual & Trailers Ahead of July 4 Premiere
content: GROW UP SHOW: Sunflower Circus (stylized as GROW UP SHOW ~Sunflower Circus~ ) original anime has revealed a new main visual and two PV trailers ahead of its July 4 premiere. The anime will be produced by Aniplex, with animation by A-1 Pictures alongside its new internal animation label, Psyde Kick Studio .
author: Anime Corner

title: Grow Up Show: Himawari no Circus-dan Anime's Ads Reveal Theme Song Artists, July 4 Debut
content: Aniplex , A-1 Pictures , and Psyde Kick Studio presented the second set of television commercials and a new main visual for their original anime project Grow Up Show: Himawari no Circus-dan (Grow Up Show: The Sunflower Circus Troupe) on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Code Lyoko Shares Surprising Update on Long-Awaited Sequel
content: Cartoon Network has been seeing major success in returning to some of its biggest franchises in recent days. Specifically, franchises such as The Amazing World of Gumball, Adventure Time , and Regular Show have released various spin-offs and/or sequels to help further expand on their respective universes.
author: ComicBook

title: Girls' Last Tour Manga Gets Prologue Manga Series on June 26
content: Shinchosha 's Kurage Bunch manga web service announced on Saturday that Tsukumizu will launch the Kaisō Toshi Danpen-Shū (A Collection of Fragments From Megacity) manga series on June 26. The collection of short stories serves as a prologue to Tsukumizu 's Girls' Last Tour ( Shōjo Shūmatsu Ryokō ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Classroom of the Elite: Year 3 Light Novel Tops Oricon's Monthly Light Novel Ranking for May 2026
content: The fourth volume of writer Shogo Kinugasa and illustrator Shunsaku Tomose 's Classroom of the Elite : Year 3 light novel series topped the chart, selling 58,242 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on May 25. The series' Classroom of the Elite: Year 2 novels ended in 2024 with volume 12.5.
author: ANN

title: Kingdom Manga Tops Oricon's Monthly Comic Ranking for May 2026
content: The 79th volume of Yasuhisa Hara 's long-running Kingdom manga topped the chart, selling 356,559 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on May 19. Viz Media began releasing the manga in English last November.
author: ANN

title: 'Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun' Season 4's 2nd Main Promo Video Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the anime of Osamu Nishi 's Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) manga presented the second main promotional video and second main visual for the anime's ongoing fourth season on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Tomb Raider King Animated Series' 2nd Video Unveils Ending Song, More Cast
content: Kadokawa presented the second Japanese-language promotional video for the Korean-animated adaptation of artist 3B2S , storywriter Yuns ( REDICE STUDIO ), original storywriter SAN.G , and character designer P-crush 's Tomb Raider King webtoon on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Junji Ito Omnibus Series Unveils Teaser, Ending Song Artist, Anime Expo Premiere
content: TV Tokyo presented the teaser video, a key visual, and more details for Strange -Itō Junji no Yoru mo Nemurenu Kimyō na Hanashi- (Strange - Junji Ito 's Strange Stories for Sleepless Nights), the live-action omnibus series based on 13 manga stories by Junji Ito , on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 3 Years Later, One of The Most Stunning Series Confirms an Anime Adaptation
content: The Shojo industry is witnessing a major change in recent years as the demographic keeps announcing new and exciting anime adaptations. For several decades now, most of the mainstream hits have always been battle Shonen, including Dragon Ball, One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen , and many more.
author: ComicBook
